lineage.strategy: Use latest issuer quarterly results to source current revenue, margin, cash generation and commercialization execution.

observations.fact: Mobileye reported Q2 2026 revenue of $508 million, roughly flat year over year, while six-month revenue reached $1.066 billion versus $944 million a year earlier.

Q2 GAAP gross margin fell to 46% from 50%, while adjusted operating income rose to $155 million; management said the operating improvement was materially aided by a newly enacted Israeli R&D incentive grant.

Mobileye generated $210 million of operating cash flow in the first half of 2026 and held $1.4 billion of cash, marketable securities and deposits; full-year revenue guidance was narrowed upward to $1.970-$2.020 billion.

risks.risk: Underlying revenue was flat in Q2 and gross margin compressed; a large portion of the adjusted operating-income guidance improvement comes from the R&D incentive rather than purely operating leverage.

unknowns.unknown: Robotaxi and humanoid initiatives are progressing operationally but the release does not provide realized standalone revenue or unit economics for those newer businesses.

recommendation: Use the reported revenue, margin, cash and guidance evidence while separating incentive-driven profit uplift and pre-revenue autonomy initiatives from recurring operating economics.
